lines.en: Oh my baby, are you alright?
Hey! Don't get any blood on my floor!
My son is hurt, what's wrong with you?
For one thing, I got a wart that needs cream on it!
Aw, come on, we don't have time for this!
Our dinner reservations are in 20 minutes!
Well, you'll just have to go without me!
Ah, no worries. I like hitting ladies with pineapples.
Hit her with it again! She's still breathing!
Why? I'm busy trimming my wart hairs!
Yeah, um, I was just wondering if I got a package yet from the iWeb Awards?
No! Now quit upsetting my wart!
Because this guy in England said he was going to send it like a week ago.
Mommy! That man ate my cookie!
You got clouds falling all over your face and all over my face!
That man took my son's cookie!
What are you going to do about it?
Hey, is that my package from England?
It's the last part I need to finish that motorcycle.
I'm Spencer! I got a choke knob!
Do you know how hard it is to find an original choke knob for a 19th school?
You sneezed all over my face and tongue!
Tell it to your choke knob!
Why do you think I'm making fun of--
What's with that fake wart on your face?
You think I'm happy this thing grew here?
You think I like that it has hair?
No, my mom made this costume.
I see you're all packed up.
What are you kids doing with that pumpkin?
We're going to roll it down the street!
I'll tell you who it is.
I stole all the TV remotes!
Wilbert, why would you steal TV remotes?
Because I love the way they feel against my skin in the moonlight!
How long will he be in jail?
How long for slapping a cop?
Um, we brought you some food.
I don't eat nothing unless it's dead!
Okay, I guess that's better than the other way around.
Oh, and, um, we got you these flowers.
Oh, hey, what'd you spend on these, $7.95?
Ow, I just need to check my mail!
I will leave in a minute!
I got any rates in this middle!
Everything you want to treat us like this!
In the event of a power outage, I gotta check on everyone in the--
How come you guys got power?
Well, you're not allowed to use those devices in your apartment.
Oh, come on, just let us use them.
Well, I suppose I could let it slide if you let me hang out here in the nice cool air.
We've done everything you've asked us for the past five days.
You might try saying thanks once.
You didn't install an air conditioner!
We don't have enough money to buy you an air conditioner!
You're just lucky Freddy's putting up that ceiling fan for you.
Well, I'd feel lucky if I were drinking some tomato juice!
I'll get you some tomato juice.
Sam, hand me my needle nose pliers.
Ten years ago, after we dated for five weeks, I tried to break up with her.
I took her on a cruise.
And when we were a mile off the coast of Puerto Vallarta, I jumped overboard and swam to shore.
Then I moved to Seattle, changed my last name, and got a job as a stinking doorman.
